reported_status: ROOT proves that every universal exact whole-batch sampler in the unknown-law model needs at least m expected NEW Q-source queries for EVERY fixed P,Q, including zero atoms, with no exponential-moment or hard-cap assumption. Existing exact empirical matching attains this floor with zero new P queries when m>=ceil((d-1)/eta^2), so the full minimax value is EXACTLY m throughout that regime. A charged symmetrization reduction also proves C*(d,m,eta)>=C*(d,1,eta)-(m-1). The smaller-batch/all-log minimax problem remains OPEN. Earlier finite-alphabet, conditional countable-archive, paid DDB1 and response-reuse results remain valid at their separately stated contracts.
